inherited_contract_traces.role: Scalp cap channel distinctions and actual storage
inherited_contract_traces.trace: ScalpCap stores model-space metre positions, smooth model-space normals, scalp-map UVs, directional tangent+handedness, triangle vertex slots and opacity. Same primitive arrays do not imply same frame/unit/role. Private fit produces these together and prepare stores cap next to placement and scalp texture. Public fields do not establish arbitrary caller mutations preserve length/identity; coherent owner record does not itself validate all stream associations. No renderer/serialization/skin binding body coverage inferred from exported names.

Each original scalp point is mapped by HeadPlacement.point into model space before MeshCollider.query and metre CAP_LIFT offset; smooth normals use distinct inverse-transpose normal mapping. UV uses original bust point, and opacity hairline uses original bust point/head rather than deformed model point. ScalpMap.fit computes center/axis/side/forward/rim from that scalp and head; uv rejects out-of-map direction and maps its unit disk to square, returning normalized texture coordinates. fit uses unwrap_or_default UV fallback; no universal proof that every arbitrary/degenerate Surface point maps successfully is claimed. Head.above_hairline returns signed metre height difference at bust azimuth; cap subtracts metre stepped-edge allowance and divides by metre softness before smoothstep. Signed distance, normal direction, UV and opacity remain distinct meaningful roles.

Collider.query explicitly returns signed distance (negative inside) plus outward direction; distance delegates to query. MeshCollider owns a BVH and same cloned positions/triangle order plus derived vertex normals/reach. query selects closest triangle and uses barycentric normals to orient distance/outward vector, returning reach/up outside query radius. BodySurface metre positions/faces supplied to place are copied into MeshCollider with BODY_REACH0.1; on_bust builds collider from head mesh and uses identity placement. This first-party numerical port explains local raw float/Vec3 tuple operations without certifying every external body mesh, finite state, normal or algorithm outcome. Named query record could clarify heterogeneous tuple roles if a coherent owner repair is later chosen; no new canonical alias or unique finding accepted.

inherited_contract_traces.role: Actual retained scalp/head/map association and pending producer
inherited_contract_traces.trace: grow derives head from look, cuts GPU scalp for that head, reads scalp into Surface, then fits ScalpMap from that same head/scalp. These retained fields are passed together into cap.fit; no separate reordering is introduced in cap. Surface owns raw parallel positions/normals/UVs/triangles, with optional constructor channels; its constructor computes defaults and derived BVH but does not prove supplied normals/UV lengths. CPU Head.mesh/scalp derives same-index normals/UVs and remaps them with positions when clipping triangles, but that CPU producer is not the actual grow GPU readback path. Therefore no substitute producer proof: exact cut_scalp/GpuScalp.read body is still necessary for source-complete actual producer trace.

Input position/normal/UV arrays use same scalp triangle vertex slots. Native triangle-edge displacements and UV determinant produce along-u/along-v accumulators; projection removes normal component, normalizes finite nonzero direction and emits tangentxyz plus sign chosen by normal cross tangent dotv. Degenerate UV area and invalid tangent length have explicit kernel fallbacks. Signed handedness is a closed native rendering component, not independent human role enum. No new epsilon, tolerance, finite geometry bound or orthogonal-fallback correctness guarantee invented. Public channel association remains qualified beyond private producer chain.

clear_skin generates homogeneous barycentric weights from DIP_STEPS4 using nonzero fixed denominator and fixed-sum construction, samples triangle dips, accumulates per-vertex max metre lift, and performs DIP_PASSES4 bounded correction passes using native body distance/query. These are sampled iterative numerical policies, not proof of continuous all-triangle clearance. edge_fade keeps canonicalized undirected edge pairs, triangle incidence counts, vertex neighbours and BFS row distances; MAX denotes unvisited local workspace, then row/EDGE_FADE_ROWS maps to clampedopacity. Homogeneous vertex pairs/triangles/barycentric weights and numerical workspace slots do not warrant enum variants for arbitrary ordinals. Physical metre offsets, sampling/pass counts, graph row distance and output opacity must not be conflated solely by storage type.

new_contract_traces.role: Actual native readback to Surface adapter
new_contract_traces.trace: GpuScalp.read interprets the three retained streams as padded [f32;4] native elements, truncates each by the same stored vertex count, takes xyz for position/normal andxy for UV, and reads padded [u32;4] triangle records truncated by stored triangle count before taking xyz. These explicit homogeneous native representations are real GPU layout adapters. trimmed changes Buffer.size through canonical BufferByteLength, retaining max16 minimum native allocation/view length; same vertex-byte request applies to all three streams. Zero vertex count would truncate each to empty rather than invent one semantic vertex. Ordered metadata read_words copies each requested word to matching enumeration slot, checks returned word length and returns exact requested prefix, so vertex/area/bounds field selectors are explicit native metadata layout, not unordered independent domain values. Generic Buffer.read/kernel/driver internals were not re-audited; successful decoding and same-count wiring establish this particular host association, not universal GPU validity.
